name: handdrawn-promo-video
description: Research a topic (company, service, website, product) and render a short promo video as an MP4 in one of five code-drawn styles (hand-drawn with 8-bit minis, brand motion graphics, sand art, lyric music video, beat-synced footage): style and settings questions → sourced research → storyboard approval → build, QA, and render, with code-generated music where the style calls for it.
